🚨 BIG WIN for Vietnam 🇻🇳‼️
FTSE Russell Officially Upgrades to Emerging Market Status – Billions in Inflows Incoming? 🇻🇳
( Videos & Sources below 👇) 
Vietnam has just secured its long-awaited upgrade from Frontier to Secondary Emerging Market status by FTSE Russell!
Confirmed this week, the change kicks in from September 21, 2026, with Vietnamese stocks being added to global equity indices in four phases through 2027.
This milestone is expected to unlock up to $6 billion in foreign capital, boost liquidity, and put Vietnam alongside powerhouses like India, Indonesia, and the Philippines in the emerging markets club.
After years of reforms (including global broker access and market improvements), this is a major step in Vietnam’s integration into the global financial system.
Stocks already rallied on the news — is this the start of a new bull run for Vietnam’s market?
What do investors think? 
Drop your take below 👇
#Vietnam #FTSE #EmergingMarkets #Investing #AsiaEconomy #VNIndex

These videos discuss the September 21, 2026 effective date, phased inclusion, and investor implications.

These reports confirm the upgrade to Secondary Emerging status, effective September 21, 2026, with phased implementation (10% / 20% / 35% / 35%) through 2027, following successful market reforms.
